estimates: The official register gives three attached two-storey wings and court dimensions near 16.5 m by 10.8 m. The mapped outline constrains the exterior and the wing roofs are fitted to its courtyard junctions.
The current mortar color, levels and exact fenestration are estimated. The west stepped gable follows the register description.
The preserved terrain shows local grades at regional source resolution. Small threshold elevations are estimated.

review.notes: The exact public-domain photographs in Qualla establish the church, Holy Stairs Chapel and the open courtyard arcade. They do not provide an identifiable exterior of the three monastery house wings. Remaining house photographs carry attribution or share-alike requirements. The model follows the architectural register and OpenStreetMap.
